inlines.v: DIZZY, adjective [G., dizziness; dizzy ] 1. Giddy; having a sensation of whirling in the head, with instability or proneness to fall; vertiginous. 2. Causing giddiness; as a dizzy highth. 3. Giddy; thoughtless; heedless; as the dizzy multitude. DIZZY, verb transitive To whirl round; to make giddy; to confuse.
